name: Waitlist alert
purpose: Tells the owner what shoppers are waiting for.
trigger: someone asks to be told about a sold-out product

steps.name: Note to the owner
steps.job: Which product and which customer, sent to the shop's own inbox.

rules: Internal only. No customer sees it.
why: Every signup is a demand signal. It shows what to reorder first.
watch: A popular product can flood the inbox. Move to a daily summary as volume grows.
